name: google-drive
author: John P. Giatropoulos
description: Granular Google Drive widgets — file list, search, and file preview.

widgets.name: GDriveFileList
widgets.description: Sortable file and folder list from Google Drive. Click a file to publish a fileSelected event.

widgets.name: GDriveFileSearch
widgets.description: Search Google Drive files by query. Shows file name, type, and modified date. Click a result to publish a fileSelected event.

widgets.name: GDriveFilePreview
widgets.description: Display file metadata for a selected Google Drive file. Listens for fileSelected events.

widgets.name: GoogleDriveWidget
widgets.description: Browse and search files in Google Drive via the Google Drive MCP provider.
